method: Visual review of every PDF page plus MIDI duration, meter, filename, and prior pitch/span evidence. Private names and paths are represented only by SHA-256 identities.

items.repeats: printed repeat barlines and first/second endings are present; the MIDI timeline is expanded
items.transcription_alignment: prior pitch/note/span evidence is strong but uses incompatible repeat semantics
items.reason: Exclude from printed-page scoring; retain for expanded-repeat playback diagnostics.

items.edition: same composer and arranger are named
items.page_coverage: eight pages cover measures 1-120; MIDI duration is exactly 480 quarter notes
items.transcription_alignment: prior pitch agreement 0.992 and note ratio 0.997
items.reason: Eligible as an already-inspected application diagnostic, not as an untouched test item.

items.edition: reference carries no arranger or edition metadata
items.page_coverage: four pages cover measures 1-120; MIDI duration is exactly 480 quarter notes
items.transcription_alignment: prior pitch evidence is strong but cannot establish the edition
items.reason: Exclude until an edition-identifiable symbolic reference is available.

items.page_coverage: eleven printed pages; prior span ratio is 0.99 but complex meter changes prevent independent MIDI-only coverage proof
items.pickup: MIDI duration ends on a half-quarter boundary; pickup status is unresolved
items.transcription_alignment: prior pitch agreement is 0.924, insufficient to prove the same edition
items.reason: Exclude until a matching MusicXML reference establishes meter, pickup, and edition.

items.edition: PDF describes itself as an arrangement similar to the original; MIDI edition is unidentified
items.page_coverage: PDF reaches measure 53 while the MIDI duration is only 152.5 quarter notes
items.transcription_alignment: prior note ratio near 1.0 came from an incomplete transcription and does not prove full-score alignment
items.reason: Exclude because the reference does not cover the complete printed score.

items.edition: PDF does not identify its arranger; MIDI carries no edition metadata
items.page_coverage: six pages and 252 MIDI quarter notes are plausibly complete but not independently edition-matched
items.transcription_alignment: prior pitch agreement 0.959 is strong but cannot establish edition identity
items.reason: Exclude until the reference provenance identifies the arrangement.

items.edition: PDF explicitly names a different arranger while reusing another PDF's MIDI reference
items.page_coverage: six printed pages; reused MIDI duration is 252 quarter notes
items.transcription_alignment: prior pitch agreement 0.734 is consistent with an arrangement mismatch
items.reason: Exclude because the PDF and reference are different arrangements.
